faq.q: Where do Ladner condos under $800K actually sit?
faq.a: On the page text read for this file, the feed's cards are labelled Hawthorne, Ladner Elementary and Delta Manor — the central-Ladner stock around the village core; on official sources, Ladner Village sits west of Chilukthan Slough per the Official Community Plan, and the City documents a multi-family apartment building within the Marina Garden Estates application in Neilsen Grove.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Ladner condo?
faq.a: School District 37, address-based. The verified samples: 5500 Admiral Boulevard feeds Neilson Grove Elementary (K–7) and Delta Secondary (8–12), and 4600 53 Street feeds Ladner Elementary (K–7) and Delta Secondary (8–12). Check the exact address in the SD37 School Locator — catchments are not assigned by building name.

faq.q: What flood questions should I ask on a Ladner condo?
faq.a: Whether the building is within 30 m of a stream, slough or ditch (the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area), and how the strata's depreciation report and insurance certificate treat Ladner's setting behind the City's flood-protection system — over 63 km of dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection, 31 drainage pump stations and about 538 km of drainage infrastructure.
